items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XI, List of Answers on Topics 65:1
items.html: In the pregnancy of the pregnancy, namely in the three days of absorption, the NHY of AA are not yet discerned as divided into three thirds, but are still complete measures; hence ZA receives from Netzah, and his Nukva from Hod, and he also receives from the Tifferet and Yesod of AA, which are the phase of the middle line and the root of ZA. And in the nursing of the pregnancy, namely in the forty days, the NHY of AA are already discerned as divided into three thirds: the two upper thirds of the NH ascended to the HGT of AVI, to the phase of breasts, and ZA receives from the four joints of the NH that remained below, in the NHY of AA, and likewise from the Tifferet and Yesod; and thereby the VAK are revealed in him. And in the third period, which is the Gadlut of the pregnancy, namely in the three months of the recognizability of the fetus, ZAT receives from the four joints of the NH that remained below, and KHB receives from the Tifferet and Yesod of AA. And in the fourth period, which is at the completion of the exit of the three months, then the Keter enters him from the Yesod of Atik. And all this is in the first, lower chamber, for the phase of the vessels; and in like manner those four periods apply also in the second chamber, for the need of the sparks; and in like manner also in the upper chamber, for the need of the lights.
